blocks.text: 1 Chronicles 8 contains 40 verses. It opens with: And Benjamin begat Bela his first-born, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third, It concludes with: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and had many sons, and sons' sons, a hundred and fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: The genealogies are selective literary maps of kinship, land, office, and restored identity rather than exhaustive modern biological pedigrees; gaps, parallel lines, variant names, and telescoping require case-by-case review.
